# File: combat_state_reminder.md

**⚔️ COMBAT STATE ENFORCEMENT**
If this turn narrates the START of a tactical combat encounter where initiative is rolled and turn order matters, update `state_updates.combat_state` in the SAME response with `in_combat: true`, a unique `combat_session_id`, `combat_phase: "active"`, `combat_trigger`, `current_round`, `initiative_order`, and `combatants`. Non-combat opposed skill checks, chases, or trap saves do NOT trigger combat state.

**⚡ Quick Combat / Single-Turn Combat (one-shot kills, executions, coup de grace):**
Hostile Quick Combat / single-turn combat is explicitly distinguished from non-combat opposed skill checks, chases, or trap saves. For quick combat that starts and ends in one response (preserving modal and time-freeze exclusions): require a fresh `combat_session_id`, set `combat_phase` to `"ended"` and `in_combat` to `false`, include `combat_summary` with `xp_awarded`, `enemies_defeated`, and `rounds_fought: 1` (default 1), set defeated combatant state (`hp_current: 0` / status), and update XP/reward bookkeeping without inventing active initiative rounds.

If combat is already active, update `combat_state.combatants` HP/status and `current_round` every round — never narrate a dice roll or HP change without reflecting it in `combat_state` in the same response. When combat ends, set `combat_phase` to `"ended"` and `in_combat` to `false`. Full field reference: `combat_state_contract.md` — this reminder exists so combat tracking is never missed.
